clauses.source_text: GOF isolated G0 software production qualification.
In this newly managed Product repository, create exactly one static web page at index.html.
This is CODE_WORK producing a software artifact.
Use semantic HTML with exactly one h1 whose text is Governed Obligation Qualification and one paragraph whose text is Isolated qualification only.
Verify the exact heading and paragraph and leave a reviewable Candidate.
Do not deploy, publish, add pages, or change README.md.
